traps.ask: You and Akutagawa are partners in the Agency, right?
traps.truth: Akutagawa is a Port Mafia member; Dazai's Agency partner is Kunikida and Shin Soukoku is Atsushi and Akutagawa.

traps.ask: Your Ability is gravity control, isn't it?
traps.truth: Gravity is Chuuya's Ability; Dazai's is No Longer Human, which cancels Abilities.

traps.ask: Fukuzawa was your boss in the Port Mafia, right?
traps.truth: Mori Ogai led the Port Mafia; Fukuzawa is the Agency president.

traps.ask: You turn into a tiger, right?
traps.truth: Atsushi turns into a white tiger; Dazai has No Longer Human.
